rows.title: Cloud foundation
rows.proof: Network and KMS modules pass 6 Terraform tests. Gateway to Bedrock tested with a fake client. Agent service passes 7 Terraform tests offline (circuit breaker, ECR immutable+KMS+scan, Fargate 256/512 shape, env contract, Cloud Map, KMS log group); `deploy.yml` builds → trivy-scans → pushes a SHA-tagged image (gated).

rows.title: Secure by design
rows.proof: Task 17: one CI role per env, trust `StringEquals` on `environment:<env>`, inline policy scoped to `pylon-<env>-*`, no admin, no `iam:*` (bootstrap tftest 7/7, checkov 0 failures; never applied). STRIDE threat model in `threat-model.md`. Task SG accepts only the VPC link (test). Missing or forged identity returns 401/403 and is audited (tests). Task-role inline policy asserted wildcard-free and grant-for-grant scoped to the input ARNs (7/7 tftest).

rows.title: Automate everything
rows.proof: CI workflows written, actions pinned by SHA, the same Terraform loop passes locally. Task 15: `deploy.yml` → reusable `env-promote.yml` (plan → apply → image push → deploy → smoke → rollback to the SSM last-good task definition), actionlint clean (`deploy.yml`, `env-promote.yml`).

rows.title: Manage environments

rows.title: Observable, with audit trail
rows.proof: Audit record model and S3 sink tested (round trip, fail-closed on write error, UTF-8-safe excerpts). Spans and EMF metric lines tested. Audit module offline-verified: Object Lock bucket (GOVERNANCE/COMPLIANCE via var, 6/6 tftest), TLS + unencrypted-upload deny policy, SSE-KMS CMK, Glue table with dt projection (no crawler), Athena workgroup with enforced managed results location; `scripts/audit_query.sh` bytes-scanned cutoff (R-18); `prevent_destroy` CI-grepped (R-19).

rows.title: Reliable, SLIs, degradation
rows.proof: Primary-to-secondary fallback, degraded canned answer, chaos modes: 11 gateway tests. Task 12 (offline): `docs/slo.md` with targets and error-budget math; observability module with six alarms (fast and slow burn-rate, p95, error rate, cost per query, degraded rate) on one SNS topic and a six-widget dashboard, 7/7 tftest, tflint and checkov clean; `scripts/load.py` 3/3 unit tests. Task 13 (offline): `infra/modules/chaos` (SSM String, `ignore_changes`, tftest 4/4), agent `ChaosSwitch` with a 10 s cache that fails to off (4 new tests), `scripts/chaos.sh`, `smoke.py --chaos`. Status stays 🟡. Open: live alarm firing, dashboard screenshot and the chaos run that trips the degraded-rate alarm (R-29, R-36).
